name: Hybrid Ray-Casting and Shear-Warp with RLE Compression
aliases: New combination of ray-casting and shear-warp
definition: A hybrid algorithm combining image-order (shear-warp) and object-order (ray-casting) techniques to render large RLE-compressed volumes interactively on a normal PC, removing the 3-fold redundancy of classified volumes found in the original shear-warp implementation.
summary: This hybrid algorithm renders RLE-compressed volumes interactively by combining shear-warp and ray-casting, reducing memory usage by eliminating data redundancy while maintaining high image quality.
